nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Listens for incoming Telegram messages to your bot.

parameters.text:
I couldn't figure out which project you mean. Try something like:

• where did I stop on <project name>
• status on <project name>

nodes.name: Reply – Ask for Project
nodes.notes: Fallback reply when no project name was parsed.

nodes.name: Read Project Log
nodes.notes: After import: select the 'Project Log' spreadsheet and its sheet from the dropdowns.

parameters.text: ={{ `No log entries found for project "${$json.projectName}". Double-check the name in your Google Sheet.` }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ system_instruction: { parts: [{ text: 'You are reconstructing full context on one project for someone returning to it after a break. Given the full log history below, write a detailed but tight explanation (100-180 words): what\'s been done overall, where things currently stand, what the last blocker or decision was, and the single next step. Be specific and reference actual details from the log — do not generalize or add advice not grounded in the log.' }] }, contents: [ { role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.formattedText }] } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Gemini LLM – Query
nodes.notes: Credential 'Gemini API': Header Auth with Name = 'x-goog-api-key', Value = '<YOUR_GEMINI_KEY>' (no 'Bearer' prefix). Same credential as Workflow A.

nodes.name: Reply – LLM Answer
nodes.notes: Text field reads Gemini's response shape (candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) — do NOT use the old choices[0].message.content path, which silently resolves to 'undefined'.
